Keep the full object comfortably inside the image with 7-10% transparent margins.
Palette/style continuity: warm ivory outer bone with restrained peach/coral washes in recesses; a narrow smooth muted sage-teal cartilage cap at the articulating femoral head only. Light from the upper left, subtle painted shading and refined texture rather than hard glossy lighting. Warm patient-friendly layered illustration aesthetic, accurate recognizable shape, clean silhouette, generous detail suitable for a 1080p video.
Constraints: intact healthy bone, no cutaway, fractures, necrosis, dark stains, blood, dense pores, or gore. NO typography, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, frames, circles, watermark, background paper rectangle, or checkerboard rendered into the pixels. Actual transparent alpha outside the femur.
